subject: delta(client): WF choose the merged package manifest and native transport with the stabilised genesis read and move the record anchor to the merge
note: Both sides of the merge recorded the package manifest and the native transport; this record chooses the merged copies. The package manifest's files list keeps the base's chain identity read module and this change's native dispatch history and withheld reopen grant modules. The native transport keeps every line of the base that reads the node's chain identity and passes a stabilised genesis pin to every binder it builds, and every line of this change's explicit reopen of a withheld broadcast. The commit also moves the anchor to the merge, so the anchored files start from their merged copies.
